checks_run.procedure: Independent A24/A25 negative tests: 25 validator-rejection and candidate-integrity cases plus a control, built on an independent disposable-git fixture. Covers a missing reviewer (a missing file, role substitution, a missing audit), authorship by the auditor, shared invocation (reviewer and auditor; the same session under different run IDs), an errored run, a FAIL check, a BLOCKED verdict, BLOCKED or missing gate test evidence, unresolved OPEN High, High as ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION, CLOSED_VERIFIED without verification, a dangling finding reference, BLOCKED, evidence-less and final_gate_ids-mismatched DG0 rows, a PLANNED row, non-existent or malformed B/M anchors, a SOURCE row without a B block, a REQ-PB id on a USER row, a coverage matrix missing an M block or mapping to a requirement that doesn't cite it, unknown or duplicate coverage rows, missing rationale, an added or deleted file after freeze, a committed post-freeze change through the CLI (exit 1), a self-consistent forged manifest, a manifest whose stage or commit disagree, metadata writes in every excluded area leaving the ID unchanged, and a spec unable to re-include metadata. All of these were run against the candidate's tools/gates

checks_run.actual: 27/27 of these cases pass (control, QA-N01..QA-N26). Of these, 20+ are not present in tools/gates/tests (for example QA-N06, N07, N09, N10, N11, N12, N13, N14, N15, N16, N17, N18, N19, N20, N21, N22, N23, N24, N25, N26)

summary: FAIL. All seven assigned commands pass. 27 of 29 independent negative tests pass. The register (410 rows) and coverage matrices are exactly complete and consistent. Agent-load evidence and the live guard probe confirm ten distinct, guarded invocations on the orchestrator's model. A01-A28 are feasible and fully mapped. One Medium mandatory gap blocks: F-DG0-201, where the validator doesn't bind a review's invocation to its task/assignment or freeze time, so the existing LOAD-check runs could back fabricated reviews. There are two Low observations: F-DG0-202 (bare evidence names aren't existence-checked) and F-DG0-203 (stage-plan test-authorship timing).
